Each design\'s own: the comma four\'s exact frame, the comma 3\'s screen extended to fill, CommaView filling the landscape screen.
Exact
The design\'s own shape and framing, exactly; black bars where this screen\'s shape differs.
Extend
No bars: the design keeps its size and shows more of the camera where this screen is wider or taller.
Fill screen
Fill the available display by cropping the design\'s frame.
A flowing path, a lock-on for the car ahead and CommaView\'s own speed, status and alerts. Fill the landscape screen or show the full camera.
Camera framing
Choose how CommaView uses the landscape display.
Full camera
Show the entire camera image, with black bars where needed.
Fill the landscape display by cropping the camera image. Portrait keeps the full camera.
Choose how the pack\'s screen uses the landscape display.
%1$s, an overlay pack\'s own screen: it draws on the road camera, with CommaView\'s alerts on top.
The comma 3X screen: a status border, the MAX box, a large speed and alerts along the bottom.
The comma four\'s screen: MAX above the road as it changes, the wheel and confidence beside it.
Preview framing
Match the comma four\'s frame exactly, show more of the camera, or crop it to fill this screen.
